profile_text.body:
Ambarella Inc is a public company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, traded under the ticker AMBA and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001280263. Its website describes it as a maker of AI vision processors for edge applications, and the company says its advanced imaging solutions make cameras smarter by extracting valuable data from high-resolution video streams. It lists automotive uses including advanced driver assistance systems, smart electronic mirrors, drive recorders and autonomous vehicles.

The site material does not name specific products, and no products are otherwise recorded for the company. No lawsuits, MCP servers or patent facts are present in the available data.
